name: peek
description: See the pictures Claude looks at: under each Read or screenshot in the conversation, and under each prompt you paste a picture into, a small thumbnail, large under ctrl+o or with a click on its zoom button in fullscreen, drawn with the terminal's own pictures

size.title: Picture size in the conversation
size.description: small: a thumbnail about 5 rows tall. large: up to 16 rows and the full width. ctrl+o and the zoom button always draw them large
